description: This file defines the implementation of the MediaKeysTestBase class, which provides setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing media key management in a media server environment. It includes mock object creation, media key session management, and thread task handling.

classes.name: MediaKeysTestBase
classes.description: A base class for media key testing, providing setup and utility functions for creating and destroying media keys and key sessions, and managing thread tasks.

methods.name: MediaKeysTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects for media key testing.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Creates media keys with a specified key system, setting up necessary mocks and initializing the media keys object.

methods.name: destroyMediaKeys
methods.description: Destroys the media keys object, unregistering the client and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a media key session for a given key system, setting up mocks and invoking the creation method.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets up an expectation that a task will be enqueued on the main thread and executed immediately.
